notes: Third redesign of this domain. Brief: Thaayanbu + Naadu Nalam, iyarkai panchabhootham, seven generations (ezhu thalaimurai) of a Tamil family.
User chose free-licence photos (Unsplash License) for people/landscapes; generated images were not possible on this machine. Credits in PHOTO-CREDITS.md.
Shop actions stay inside the redesign (scroll/WhatsApp/call) - no links back to the original domain.

Store pages added 2026-11-19: /shop, /wishlist, /cart, /checkout. Catalogue = the original store's 82 products (names, Tamil names, prices, pack sizes, product photos) in src/lib/products.ts. Cart + wishlist live in localStorage; checkout validates and hands the order to WhatsApp (no payment backend). Each store page ends with a closing section sized to share the screen with the footer.

2026-11-19: user asked to change the font style across the whole site to look premium. Caveat Brush / Caveat / Catamaran replaced by Fraunces (headings, prices, wordmark, product names) + DM Sans (text, buttons, forms) + Noto Serif Tamil (all Tamil). Body 17px/1.6; sizes were retuned because Caveat rendered ~20% smaller.

2026-11-19: hero arches replaced by soft editorial frames (24px radius: one tall + two stacked) with new Unsplash photos (pongal pot on wood fire, three generations, paddy basket). Cards never lift or cast shadows on hover (user: no overlay/underlay). Shop grid rows are sized to the screen (useFitRows) so the first screen ends on a whole row and nothing peeks from below.
2026-11-19: user wants one font style per heading: no italic or lighter-weight words mixed into a headline (hero 'seven generations' is now upright Fraunces 400; italic face no longer loaded).

2026-11-19: hero photos must be relevant to the brand: user chose 'Tamil family + your products'. Hero = gen1-parents (Tamil family at pooja) wide across the top + two store product shots (Mappillai samba rice in clay pot, Nallennai gingelly oil). Generic stock (smoking pot, non-Tamil family, raw paddy) was rejected.
